Hi Oliver — thanks for sending these over. Quick update from procurement review: our IRS TIN/ID verification via the API returned a mismatch on the EIN name string vs. the W-8BEN-E. That doesn't automatically block onboarding but triggers extra evidence.

Can you:
- Confirm the full legal name that appears on the UK company registry (Companies House) and whether the attached articles reflect any recent DBA/holding-company name?
- Provide a government-issued photo ID for the authorized signatory (scanned passport page) OR a notarized signatory certificate (we can accept apostille but need name/email match to signer).
- If easier, complete the DocuSign form we can push (link below) so we capture signature audit trail.

I'll loop in Legal (Kimberly) and Payments (Marcus) to confirm whether the apostille + bank letter are sufficient to open a conditional PO while we resolve the EIN string. Expected timeline: 3–5 business days after we receive the signatory ID.

Diego / team — thanks for flagging. TL;DR: we can accept an apostille + notarized signatory + bank letter to open a conditional PO for up to $25k of spend while we perform supplemental verification. Conditions:

- Signatory evidence: government photo ID for the signer OR a notarized signature block that explicitly names the signatory (we need to confirm the signer is an officer listed on the articles).
- Corporate identity: apostille on the certificate is good; confirm the Companies House number in the articles and send a direct Companies House link if possible.
- Payments: Marcus, require vendor to be added to escrow/conditional-payment profile and flag invoices for 30-day review.
- Tax: we will attempt a supplemental EIN match using a certified vendor (IRS TIN check). If mismatch persists after supplemental checks, Legal reserves the right to require W-9 (if US tax presence) or withholding per withholding table.

Action items for vendor (we should ask Oliver to provide):
1) high-res scan of signatory passport (photo page) or notarized signatory certificate (if they prefer not to share passport),
2) Companies House URL and confirmation of full legal name string,
3) completed DocuSign envelope (preferred for audit trail).

I will approve conditional PO issuance once items 1–3 are received and Marcus confirms payment profile.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
